title: TurnJobs queue redelivers forever: no DLQ, no maxReceiveCount
description: Found while tracing chatticus-a20667. control_plane.py:3779 _job_for_turn reads self._jobs, empty in the deadline Lambda (plane_from_env), so handle_turn_deadline's recovery re-enqueue is a no-op; and infra/lib/thin-turn-stack.ts:85 TurnJobs has no dead-letter queue or maxReceiveCount, so a failing job is retried every visibility timeout (~180s) for the 4-day retention, calling the model provider each time.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closed as obsolete (board cleanup 2026-10-20). The ticket targets the Python control_plane.py and the thin-turn TurnJobs queue, both gone (PR 467 removed python/). The TypeScript stack uses the TurnRuns, TurnProbes and ComputerStartJobs queues, each built through queueWithDeadLetter with a maxReceiveCount in infra/lib/control-plane-stack.ts on develop.

right_now_summary: Failed TurnJobs retry every 180 seconds for four days, with no DLQ or maximum receive limit.
